blurb: Guests rent pontoon boats with or without a roof, including a picnic table and deck chairs, or 15 foot aluminum motor boats. Rentals include life jackets and gas. Fishing is popular on Little Lake with various fish species available and no fishing license required on certain weekends.
extraNote: Call ahead for weekend reservations; must arrive by 9am to keep reservation · Reservations taken 1 week in advance only · Minimum rental 2 hours · Closed Tuesday and Wednesday · 76 Little Lake Drive, Barrie ON · May 9, 2026 to September 25, 2026
